pick.name: YouTube + YouTube Studio
pick.what: Long-form demos/tutorials and Shorts; Studio for analytics and, once in YPP, Test & Compare for thumbnails/titles
pick.why: Search-discoverable, compounding demo library for every product; Studio analytics and A/B testing are free
pick.free_limits: Free; YPP today: 1,000 subs + 4,000 watch hrs/12 mo or 10M Shorts views/90 days; from 2027-02-01 new applicants need 8,000 hrs or 20M Shorts views (existing partners grandfathered)

alts.name: LinkedIn native video
alts.what: Upload short demos natively to LinkedIn
alts.why: Better B2B reach per view for enterprise buyers; no search afterlife

candidates.name: LinkedIn video
candidates.verdict: Reach to buyers but no long tail

candidates.name: Instagram Reels
candidates.verdict: Consumer audience; only for B2C apps (not verified)

decision: YouTube is the only channel where a demo keeps getting found for years, so make it the home for product walkthroughs and repurpose clips to Shorts and LinkedIn. Use Studio analytics from day one; Test & Compare unlocks with YPP (RouteNote Jul 2025).
details: Shorts thumbnails/titles A/B: 'Test & Compare' fully rolled out to YPP creators per RouteNote (2025-07-21).

verify.note: Current thresholds (1,000 subs + 4,000 hrs/12mo OR 10M Shorts views/90d) correct today, but YouTube announced doubling for NEW applicants from 2027-02-01 (8,000 hrs or 20M Shorts views); Shorts ads limited to 10M-view creators.
